integrity: The proof reconstructs the modal forcing clauses and uses only finite intersection closure, pairwise intersection, and nonemptiness to obtain a least nonempty neighbourhood. Both box and diamond are then checked against that core by exact subset/hitting equivalences. The primary open-access full text was inspected around the semantic definition, structural N/K/D conditions, listed extension systems, and canonical-model discussion. Candidate-specific literature and published-finding searches found no statement of the finite principal-core collapse or its infinite tail obstruction.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to finite constructive neighbourhood frames satisfying the explicit structural N/K/D conditions, not to arbitrary frames that merely validate the corresponding formulas. It is a semantic reduction and does not establish a finite-model property. The exact count concerns labelled principal cores rather than distinct modal logics.
title: Finite NKD constructive neighbourhood frames collapse to serial relational cores
